Hi Anna / Tim — looping Soojin (APAC ops) to help pin this down.

Short summary of what's happening: when an invite is forwarded from a Gmail account that stripped the VTIMEZONE block in the .ics, recipients in other regions see the event as "floating" (Google displays the time without applying a timezone offset). The result looks like a multi-hour shift for APAC vs EU viewers.

What I recommend (quick wins):
- I'll send a corrected invite that includes explicit VTIMEZONE entries (Australia/Sydney) and a UTC start/end. That prevents "floating" behavior when forwarded.
- Ask external attendees to open the event and click "More actions -> Show original" (in the three-dot menu) to confirm the TZ line before accepting.
- If a forward already produced a ghost event, delete it and accept the corrected invite rather than trying to edit it.

I've attached corrected-demo.ics with the VTIMEZONE block and set the conferencing link to Meet (explicit URL). Vivek — please confirm Meet is OK or switch to Zoom.
